_comment: Reviewed policy is authoritative; live model discovery may only select eligible rows and cannot broaden consent or routes.

space-bunny-free.disclosure: OpenCode documents this model as zero-retention and not used for model training. It is temporarily free; availability can change. No paid fallback or automatic top-up is enabled.

longcat-2.5-preview-free.disclosure: OpenCode documents Zen models as hosted in the US and EU. For LongCat, OpenCode says the provider follows zero-retention and does not use your data for model training; LongCat is not listed among the privacy exceptions on the reviewed date. This app cannot verify per-request handling.
longcat-2.5-preview-free.cost_disclosure: OpenCode's pricing table currently lists input, output, and cached reads as free; cached writes are not listed. Pricing and availability can change. This app does not enable paid fallback or automatic top-ups.

providers.privacy_disclosure: OpenAI states API inputs and outputs are not used to train models by default unless the account opts in. Abuse-monitoring retention may still apply; this app cannot inspect account-level data controls.
providers.cost_disclosure: This API provider bills according to its current model pricing and account limits. Review current pricing before enabling; this app does not estimate charges and never enables paid fallback or automatic top-ups.

providers.privacy_disclosure: This connection uses an individual ChatGPT account. OpenAI's consumer terms say account content may be used to provide, maintain, develop, and improve services; account controls may allow opting out. This app cannot inspect those controls or verify account type. Do not send confidential or regulated information unless your account and organization's rules permit it.
providers.cost_disclosure: Billing class and remaining plan capacity are unknown to this app. ChatGPT plan features, limits, and availability are controlled by OpenAI and may change. Review the terms for your account; this app cannot estimate charges, purchase a plan, or fall back to a paid API route.

This app cannot verify the API key's tier, so user consent treats this route as data collection enabled.
providers.cost_disclosure: The API key may use free quota or billable quota depending on its project, model, and current tier. Review current pricing and billing settings before enabling; this app does not estimate charges and never enables paid fallback or automatic top-ups.
